name: DCL Kids' Menu Staples (Any Adult Can Order): Plain Chicken, Mini Steak, Salmon & Mickey Bar
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · All Main Dining Rooms (Kids' Menu)
whyItWorks: Every single night in every restaurant, adults are welcome to order off the DCL Kids' Menu—which features completely unspiced grilled chicken breast, baked salmon, mini beef tenderloin/sirloin steak, plain mac & cheese, mashed potatoes, white rice, and the Mickey Ice Cream Bar.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Whenever a main dining menu looks risky during a flare, ask your server for the Kids' Menu Grilled Chicken Breast, Baked Salmon, or Mini Steak with mashed potatoes or white rice (you can ask for an adult-sized portion!).
watchOuts: Ask for an adult-sized double portion of the protein
